query: Impact of EAC cost comp. & rev. timing on perf. obligations at Leidos Holdings, Inc. (LDOS).
final_answer: EAC cost estimate changes affect performance obligations measured with the cost-to-cost method because revenue is recognized as costs incurred / estimated total costs-at-completion (EAC); any EAC change is recognized in the period of change for the inception-to-date catch-up effect, and if estimated cost exceeds the transaction price, the full loss is recognized when known. In fiscal 2023, changes in contract estimates had a net favorable impact of $40M on income before taxes (favorable $140M, unfavorable $100M) and increased diluted EPS by $0.22. Revenue timing also affects contract assets/liabilities: unbilled receivables (contract assets) were $1,041M and deferred revenue (contract liabilities) was $442M current + $21M non-current at 12/29/2023; deferred revenue increased primarily due to timing of customer advance payments offset by revenue recognized.
